Once per short rest, ignore cover on one ranged attack.
When prone or behind cover, your first ranged attack each turn deals +1 damage.
Once per long rest, declare that you packed a small mundane item worth 25 throne gelt or less.
During a short rest, cook or brew something edible. Up to five allies regain +1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent.
Once per short rest, add your Intelligence modifier to a weapon damage roll.
When you regain hit points during a short rest, regain additional HP equal to your proficiency bonus.
Resistance to poison or radiation damage. Advantage on saves against radiation, toxins, and disease.
Once per short rest, as a bonus action, choose one ally within 60 ft. Their next attack gains +1d4 to hit.
Once per long rest, treat a failed Wisdom saving throw against fear, charm, or psychic manipulation as a success.
You can sense active psychic effects, daemonic influence, and Warp residue within 30 ft.
Gain proficiency in one skill, tool, or weapon group.
Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 hit points, you gain temporary HP equal to your level + proficiency bonus.
When you trigger Perils, reduce the psychic damage you take from that Peril’s result by your proficiency bonus.
You have advantage on checks to navigate hive districts, underhive markets, vents, hab-blocks, sump routes, and gang territory.
Once per short rest, when a creature damages you, mark it. Your next hit against it deals +1d6 damage.
Gain proficiency in Technology or an engineering tool. You have advantage on checks to repair, breach, mine, or salvage machinery.
Advantage on saves against vacuum exposure, suffocation, toxic atmosphere, and exhaustion from poor conditions.
If you move no more than half your speed on your turn, you gain +1 AC until your next turn.
Your speed increases by 5 ft while wearing light or Aeldari armour.
Once per long rest, reroll a failed Wisdom or Dexterity saving throw.
You may hide when lightly obscured by ruins, foliage, smoke, shadow, or battlefield debris.
Add +1 damage with witchblades and singing spears; these weapons count as psychic for overcoming resistance.
Once per short rest, when an enemy misses you with an attack, move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.
Gain darkvision 60 ft, or add +1d4 to a Perception check once per short rest.
Gain +1 to Athletics checks and melee damage rolls using that arm.
Gain +5 ft movement speed and advantage on saves against being knocked prone.
Gain +1 AC while not wearing heavy armour.
Advantage on saves against gas, smoke, poison, and airborne disease.
Advantage on checks to interface with cogitators, terminals, locks, and security systems.
Communicate silently with allies within 120 ft who have compatible vox systems.
Once per long rest, when reduced below half HP, gain temporary HP equal to level + Constitution modifier.
Ignore disadvantage from firing a Heavy weapon after moving once per short rest.
Once per short rest, add +1d4 to a ranged attack roll after seeing the d20 roll.
You cannot be disarmed of one held weapon unless incapacitated, restrained, or unconscious.
Gain advantage on saves against being shoved, knocked prone, or crushed.
Resistance to environmental cold and heat. Advantage on saves against exposure.
As a bonus action once per long rest, gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + Constitution modifier.
You always know mission time, elapsed time, and basic direction underground or aboard ships unless affected by Warp distortion.
You can manipulate unattended Tiny objects, hold a tool, or perform basic maintenance within 5 ft. It cannot attack.
Gain proficiency in Medicine. Once per long rest, stabilise a creature and restore 1 HP as an action.
Once per short rest, make a 1d4 bludgeoning or piercing attack as a bonus action.
Gain proficiency in Investigation or Technology. Once per long rest, reroll a failed Intelligence check.
Advantage on saves against exhaustion from forced marches, blood loss, poison, or shock.
Advantage on Intimidation checks when visible. Disadvantage on Persuasion checks in refined Imperial society.
You can mimic machine tones, vox distortion, and binharic fragments. Gain advantage on checks to communicate with Mechanicus systems if proficient in Technology.
+1 additional Warp Pressure, plus one Empowered effect below
If the power deals damage, add one additional damage die of the same type.

Increase the range by 30 ft, or increase a cone/area radius by 5 ft.
If the power grants temporary hit points, healing, protection, or a bonus, increase the value by your proficiency bonus.

If the power targets one creature and does not already affect multiple targets, target one additional creature within 10 ft of the original target. The second target takes half damage or receives half the non-damage effect, GM adjudication.
If the power belongs to your chosen discipline, you may reroll one damage die or healing die from the power.
Action. Range 60 ft. Psychic attack. On hit, 1d8 force damage.
Action. Range 30 ft. Strength save. Failure: pushed 10 ft and takes 1d6 force damage.

Reaction. Trigger: targeted by a ranged attack. Add +2 AC against that attack.

Action. Range 60 ft. Constitution save. Failure: 1d8 psychic damage, and the target cannot take reactions.

Action. Range: 60 ft. Psychic attack. On hit, 1d8 fire/radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light until your next turn.
Reaction. When you roll initiative, add 1d4 to your initiative roll.
Action. Touch an object or corpse. Learn one recent strong emotion, danger, or image attached to it.

Action. Range 90 ft. Intelligence save. Failure: 3d8 force damage; success: half. If this kills the target, reduce Warp Pressure by 1.
Action. Range 60 ft. Choose up to three creatures. Psychic attack against each target. Hit: 1d6 force damage.
Action. Range 30 ft. One creature gains temporary HP equal to 1d8 + psychic ability modifier + proficiency bonus and advantage on fear saves while they remain.
Action. Range 60 ft. Dexterity save. Failure: 2d6 fire/radiant damage and burns for 1d6 at the start of the next turn; success: half and no burn.
Action. Range 60 ft. Wisdom save. Failure: no reactions and disadvantage on next attack roll.
Bonus Action. Teleport 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space. Immediately roll for Perils even if Warp Pressure would not normally trigger it.
Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One ally gains +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength checks for 1 minute.
Action. 10-ft radius within 60 ft. Constitution save. Failure: 2d8 poison/necrotic damage and poisoned until next turn; success: half and no poison.
Reaction. When an ally within 30 ft is hit, reduce damage by 2d8 + psychic ability modifier.
Action. Range 60 ft. Strength save. Failure: 2d8 force damage, and speed becomes 0 until the end of the next turn.
Reaction. Add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see within 60 ft.
Bonus Action. Range 60 ft. One ally gains advantage on their next ranged attack before your next turn.
Action. 15-ft cone. Dexterity save. Failure: 3d6 fire/radiant damage; success: half. Daemons and corrupted creatures take +1d6.
Bonus Action. Self. 1 minute. Creatures that hit you with melee attacks take fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
Action. Range 60 ft. Wisdom save. Failure: frightened until the end of the next turn and takes 2d6 psychic damage.
Action. Range 90 ft. Intelligence save. Failure: 4d8 psychic damage; success: half. Add +1 extra Warp Pressure after resolving.

Action. Self, 10-ft aura until the start of your next turn. Allies in the aura have advantage on saving throws against psychic powers. Hostile psykers inside the aura increase Warp Pressure by +1 when using a power.
Reaction. When a creature within 60 ft uses a psychic power, force it to make a Charisma save. On a failure, it adds +1d4 to any Perils severity roll caused by that power.
Action. Range 60 ft. Strength save. Failure: 4d8 force damage and restrained until the end of the next turn; success: half and not restrained.
Action. Point within 90 ft. 15-ft radius Dexterity save. Failure: 5d6 fire/radiant damage; success:s half.
Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. Concentration up to 1 minute. Once per turn, add 1d4 to an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check by yourself or an ally within range.
Action. Touch. A creature regains 4d8 + your psychic ability modifier HP and gains advantage on Strength and Constitution saves for 1 minute.
Action. Range 30 ft. One creature regains 3d8 HP and ends one poisoned, diseased, bleeding, or crippled condition at the GM's discretion.
Action. Range 60 ft. Constitution save. Failure: 5d8 necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on Constitution saves until next turn; success: half.
Action. 10-ft radius centred on a point within 60 ft. Allies inside gain +3 AC against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.
Action. Range 60 ft. Up to three allies may immediately move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks and add 1d4 to their next d20 roll.
Action. 20-ft radius within 90 ft. Dexterity save. Failure: 4d6 fire/radiant damage and burning ground for 1 minute; success:s half.

Action. Range 60 ft. Open a screaming tear. One creature makes a Wisdom save. Failure: 6d8 psychic damage and frightened for 1 minute; repeat save at the end of each turn. Immediately add +2 extra Warp Pressure after resolving.

Action. Range 30 ft. Charisma save. Failure: target is incapacitated until the end of the next turn and takes 4d8 psychic damage. If this triggers Perils, roll Perils severity with advantage and use the higher result.

Action. 15-ft radius centred on you for 1 minute, concentration. Psychic powers cast inside the area cost +1 Warp Pressure, and allies inside the area have advantage on saving throws against psychic powers.
Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One creature gains +1 AC against ranged attacks until your next turn if it has moved or is in cover.
Bonus Action. Range 60 ft. One hidden or obscured creature makes a Wisdom save. On failure, it cannot benefit from invisibility or being hidden until your next turn.
Action. Range 30 ft. One ally gains +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
Action. Range 60 ft. Wisdom save. On failure, the target suffers -2 AC until the start of your next turn.
Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One ally gains +10 ft speed and may move through allied spaces until your next turn.
Reaction. When a creature within 60 ft makes an attack roll, subtract 1d4 from the roll.
Action. 15-ft cone. Dexterity save. Failure: 5d6 fire/radiant damage; success: half. Corrupted creatures take +1d6.
Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. For 1 minute, once per round, the target may reroll one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. Concentration.
Make a DC 12 Wisdom save. On success, reduce Warp Pressure by 1d4 + proficiency bonus. On failure, reduce it by 1 and take 1d6 psychic damage.
Reduce Warp Pressure by 1 once per short rest.
You take 1d6 psychic damage and cannot use Rune Ward until the start of your next turn.
You take 2d6 psychic damage and have disadvantage on your next psychic attack roll or psychic saving throw before the end of your next turn.
Every creature within 10 ft hears dead voices through your mind. Each creature, including you, takes 1d6 psychic damage and cannot take reactions until its next turn.
Until the end of your next turn, the first d20 roll made by you or an ally within 30 ft is reduced by 1d4.
You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn. One ally within 30 ft takes 1d6 psychic damage unless they succeed on a Wisdom save against your Psychic Save DC.
The GM chooses a Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis power you know. It immediately targets a random valid creature or location.
A 10-ft radius area within 30 ft becomes distorted terrain for 1 minute. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting there takes 2d6 force damage.
You drop to 0 hit points. Every creature within 30 ft takes 4d6 psychic damage. You gain 1 Corruption or a GM-approved Doom Mark tied to Aeldari fate, spirit-stones, or daemonic pursuit.
You take 1d6 psychic damage and have disadvantage on your next saving throw against fear, charm, or corruption.
You take 2d6 psychic damage and a nearby Warp entity, cult icon, or daemon-touched creature becomes aware of your presence.
Every creature within 10 ft, including you, takes 2d6 psychic damage. The GM may describe a hostile voice, omen, or watching presence.
Creatures of your choice within 30 ft must make a Wisdom save or become frightened until the end of their next turn. After Perils is reduced, your Warp Pressure increases by 1.
You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn. Make a Charisma save against your Psychic Save DC; on a failure, gain 1 Corruption.
The GM chooses a random Malefic power you know. If you know no valid Malefic power, Terror Echo manifests instead. The target is random.

A 10-ft radius area within 30 ft becomes corrupted terrain for 1 minute. Creatures entering or starting there take 2d6 psychic damage. Daemons and corrupted creatures have advantage on their next attack made from inside it.
You drop to 0 hit points. Every creature within 30 ft takes 4d6 psychic damage. A hostile Warp entity, possession threat, or daemon sign enters the scene, and you gain 2 Corruption instead of 1.
Omen. Nightmares, whispers, marks or momentary sensory distortions.
Tainted. The signs become repeatable; appropriate psychic or religious investigation can detect them.
Scarred. Choose or gain a minor corruption scar. It should create a narrow complication, not disable the character.
Marked. Warp entities and sensitive psykers may notice you. Forbidden artefacts react more strongly to your presence.
Critical. You are a major liability to the warband. The GM must make the danger and possible remedies explicit.
Crisis. The character faces possession, mutation, damnation, martyrdom or transformation. This is a story decision involving the player and GM, not automatic immediate NPC conversion.
Lasgun or autogun; laspistol; combat blade; flak armour; 2 frag grenades; medkit or auspex.
Chainsword or heavy axe; laspistol or autopistol; flak armour; symbol of faith; 1 firebomb; 1 frag grenade.
Force sword or force staff; laspistol; heavy clothing or light armour; sanctioning brands/restraints; psychic focus; 2 Minor and 2 Standard Psychic Powers.

Restore one expended Reload cycle for plasma, melta, bolt, needle, Kin, Aeldari or other advanced ammunition when that ammunition is limited. The pack must match the weapon or ammunition type.
Carry up to four grenades ready for quick use; drawing one does not require an item interaction once per turn.
DC 12 Technology or appropriate tool check to repair one jammed, damaged, overheated or fouled weapon.
Restore one expended use of an auspex/scanner or power it for one scene.
For one mission scene, advantage on saves against gas, smoke, airborne toxins or foul atmosphere.
Seal a breached suit, cracked visor, pressure leak or small hull gap; usually DC 10 Technology or Survival under pressure.
For 1 minute, gain +10 ft speed and temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus; then make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.
Once, when you fail a save against fear, corruption or psychic horror, add 1d4 to the roll; consumed or ritually spent.
Routine class gear, common ammunition and ordinary tools.
Grenades, specialist ammunition, carapace components and surveillance gear.
Plasma fuel, advanced auspexes, quality bionics and specialist transport.
Power weapons, refractor fields, advanced implants and sealed archives.
Master-crafted wargear, conversion fields, elite vehicles and major relic access.
Named archeotech, irreplaceable prototypes and singular institutional assets.
Requires a mission, inheritance, political intervention or equivalent story event.
Any appropriate skill approved by the GM
Refusal or a dangerous source; the attempt may create Heat, debt or misinformation.
Available with a complication such as delay, substitute, debt, limited charges or damaged condition.
Available as requested for the mission or agreed period.

Issued and Controlled gear. Scarce items appear as specialist mission assets.
One Scarce item, unusual modification, or limited- use specialist ammunition.
Issued, Controlled and Scarce gear. Rare items become plausible rewards or difficult requisitions.
A Rare weapon, advanced augmetic, field or power weapon, or first master-crafted item.

Exceptional armoury access, advanced master- crafted gear, archeotech fragments or major faction-specific wargear.
Rare equipment can be expected around elite operatives. Exceptional gear remains politically and narratively important.
Exceptional or Near-Unique relic access tied to major obligations, patrons or campaign events.
A suitable ranged weapon can be used as a 1d6 piercing melee weapon without drawing another weapon. It is not Finesse unless the base weapon is Light.
Increase the weapon's Reload value by 25%, rounded up. Does not apply to Reload 1 weapons or single-use launchers.
Once per short rest, after you roll a ranged attack but before the result is declared, add +1d4 to the roll.
Advantage on one check per short rest to conceal, hide or disguise the weapon.
Once per short rest, ignore disadvantage or another penalty caused specifically by moving before firing a Heavy weapon.
When you Aim and do not move before the attack, ignore Light Cover on one ranged attack.
The first time each mission the weapon would become Damaged because of a malfunction, harsh environment or failed maintenance check, it remains Serviceable instead.
Once per turn when the weapon damages a daemon, Warp-Born creature or explicitly corrupted target, add +1 radiant damage per weapon damage die.
Choose one compatible advanced modification that normally could not be fitted to this pattern. Installation requires exceptional facilities and GM approval.
Gain +1 to attack rolls made with the item.
Once per turn when you roll weapon damage, reroll one damage die and use the new result.
Increase normal range by 25%. This does not increase maximum range beyond double the new normal range.
Increase Reload by 50%, rounded up. Does not stack with Extended Magazine.
Moving before firing no longer imposes a penalty from the Heavy property, though other Heavy restrictions still apply.
Pistol, basic firearm or compact melee weapon
Advantage on checks to conceal the item; it can be readied from concealment without an item interaction once per turn.
Increase the armour's AC by +1. A shield or field cannot gain this trait.
Once per short rest, reduce damage from one non-critical weapon hit by your proficiency bonus.
Gain advantage on saves against gas, smoke and airborne toxins. If the armour is already sealed, it also tolerates brief vacuum exposure without a separate suit breach test.
The first creature hit during the Reload cycle is easier to track; the next allied ranged attack against it before your next turn ignores Light Cover.
Projectile weapons only. Once per turn, add +1 damage against a target wearing armour of AC 13 or lower before Dexterity.
Projectile or bolt weapons only. Once during the Reload cycle, one attack gains Armour-Breaking. Declare before the attack roll.
Suitable projectile, bolt or flamer weapons. Once per turn on a hit, deal +1d4 fire damage. The ammunition is conspicuous and rarely appropriate for stealth.
Las weapons only. Once per turn, add +1d4 radiant damage, but the weapon gains Overheat for that Reload cycle.
On a hit against a daemon, Warp-Born creature or explicitly corrupted target, add +1d4 radiant damage.
Restores one Reload cycle for a matching xenos or otherwise exotic weapon. It does not grant a new property by itself.
The item must actually be recovered from the scene. A retreat, collapsing site or hostile reinforcements can make this impossible.
Use Investigation, Technology or an appropriate tool proficiency when the item's condition, traps, corruption or unfamiliar technology is uncertain.
Damaged or Worn gear may require parts, a maintenance kit, workshop time or a project before it can be trusted.
Unfamiliar, species-pattern, Mechanicus, xenos or proscribed gear may require training, an interface, ammunition or a specialist before use.
If authorities care about ownership or legality, the warband needs a believable provenance, permit, patron or very convincing lie.
Exceptionally maintained. Ignore the first event each mission that would reduce the item's Condition.
On a natural 1 during demanding use, the item becomes Damaged after resolving the action.
One property or benefit chosen by the GM is unavailable until repaired. A natural 1 during demanding use can cause complete failure.
The item cannot function until rebuilt or replaced with appropriate facilities and parts.
If the character still has an appropriate patron or institution, ordinary class equipment and common ammunition are normally replaced between authorised missions without a roll.
Usually replaced with a routine Requisition test, paperwork or a short downtime action.
Requires a Requisition test and a plausible supply source. Replacement may be delayed, substituted or issued only for a mission.
Requires strong access, Standing, a specialist source or a specific reward. Loss should matter.
Normally a campaign objective, patron decision, inheritance, major favour or difficult project rather than a routine request.
Cannot be assumed replaceable. Recovery, reconstruction or replacement should be a story in its own right.
2d10 fire; 20/60 ft; Light, Armour-Breaking, Reload 2. Aeldari-pattern cells and maintenance are normally required.
1d10 force; 40/120 ft; Armour-Breaking, Reload 6. Once per turn against AC 17+, a vehicle or a structure, deal +1d6 force damage.

2d8 force; 60/180 ft; Heavy, Armour-Breaking, Reload 6. On a hit against AC 17+, a vehicle or a Large or larger creature, it must pass a Strength saving throw or lose 10 ft Speed until your next turn.
Concealed accessory. Once per short rest, after you hit a creature within 10 ft, deal +1d6 radiant or fire damage. It is not found without a deliberate search or suitable auspex.

While held, gain advantage on saves against psychic and daemonic effects. Once per short rest, use your reaction to reduce psychic or force damage to you by 2d8; a Warp-using source also gains +1 Warp Pressure.

Force-field icon. Once per short rest, use your reaction to reduce damage to yourself by 2d8 + proficiency bonus. If this reduces the damage to 0, gain advantage on your next fear or Corruption save before the end of your next turn.

Once per short rest, when an attack hits you, use your reaction to teleport up to 10 ft to an unoccupied space you can see and halve the triggering damage. If no safe space exists, the reaction cannot be used.
2d10 force; 120/360 ft; Heavy, Beam, Emplaced, Reload 2. If the primary target is at least 60 ft away, add +1d10 force damage.

Action to deploy. Once per long rest, a friendly teleport, drop or extraction that can lock onto the homer may arrive within 10 ft of it without scatter or positional error, subject to campaign access.
Consumable. 10-ft radius; Constitution save. Failure: Restrained and Incapacitated until the start of the thrower's next turn. Success: Speed halved and no reactions for the same duration.
1d10 radiant/fire; 50/150 ft; Light, Reload 8. Once per turn when you hit a Bloodied target, deal +1d6 fire damage.
2d8 radiant/fire; 80/240 ft; Burst, Reload 12. Once per turn, if the target has already taken damage this round, deal +1d8 fire damage.

Choose one Heavy weapon you carry. You ignore its movement-based Heavy penalty. If it is Emplaced, you may fire it as though it were merely Heavy while the harness is functioning. Requires Strength 13+ or an appropriate interface.
Advantage on Technology checks to identify or operate ancient machinery. Once per short rest, after rolling an Intelligence or Technology check, add 1d8 before the result is declared.

Once per long rest when damage would reduce you to 0 HP but not kill you outright, remain at 1 HP and teleport up to 15 ft to a visible unoccupied space. The field becomes Damaged after use until properly repaired.

Once per long rest as an action, a creature you touch regains 4d8 + proficiency bonus HP and ends Poisoned or one disease. It may suppress one lasting-injury penalty until its next long rest, but does not cure the injury.

Lasgun: 1d10 radiant; 100/300 ft; Accurate, Armour-Breaking, Reload 30. Once per short rest on a hit, choose a second creature directly behind the target within 30 ft; if the original attack roll would hit it, it takes 1d10 radiant damage.

Refractor relic. Once per short rest, reaction to reduce damage to you by 2d8 + proficiency bonus; allies within 5 ft reduce the same instance of area damage by your proficiency bonus. Burden: Ecclesiarchal or Inquisitorial ownership is likely.

Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute, allies within 15 ft have advantage on fear and Corruption saves. Daemons and explicitly corrupted creatures that start their turn in the aura take radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
Arc rifle: 2d8 lightning; 80/240 ft; Shock, Armour-Breaking, Mechanicus, Reload 8. Once per short rest, a hit against a machine, vehicle or structure becomes a critical hit.

While interfaced, gain +1 to Technology checks and advantage to identify Mechanicus systems. Once per short rest, reroll a failed Technology check. Burden: the Cult Mechanicus regards the device as institutional property.

+2 AC; Ogryn only; counts as a Slab Shield. If you did not move this turn, one Small or Medium ally directly behind you has Full Cover. Once per short rest when a ranged attack misses you, move 5 ft toward the attacker without provoking opportunity attacks.

2d6 bludgeoning; Melee; Ogryn, Heavy, Brutal. Once per short rest when you miss with it, reroll the attack. If the reroll hits a Large or smaller target, it must pass a Strength save or be pushed 10 ft.
2d10 force; 150/450 ft; Accurate, Heavy, Armour-Breaking, Reload 2. Once per short rest, one attack ignores Light and Heavy Cover and one source of resistance to its weapon damage.
Oathplate of the First Claim - Kin

AC 17, max Dex +1; Kin only; no Speed penalty. Once per short rest, ignore one effect that would shove, knock you prone, or reduce your Speed. Allies within 5 ft gain +1 to saves against forced movement while you are conscious.
Ghosthelm of the Wandering Seer - Aeldari

Aeldari Warlock or GM-approved Psyker. Once per long rest when Perils trigger, treat the severity result as Warp Static. After resolving it, reduce your Warp Pressure by your proficiency bonus, minimum 0.

1d10 piercing; 180/720 ft; Accurate, Silent, Monomolecular, Reload 6. If you are Hidden and did not move this turn, attacks with it score a critical hit on 19-20. Once per short rest, ignore Heavy Cover on one attack.

Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute, you and allies within 15 ft have advantage on fear and Corruption saves; you gain resistance to psychic and force damage. Burden: visible possession attracts Ecclesiarchal attention and expectations.

Mechanicus interface. Once per long rest, treat one Technology check to unlock, disable or command a machine, security system or vehicle of DC 20 or lower as a success. Against harder systems, make the check with advantage and add 1d10. Burden: multiple forge worlds claim it.

Kin relic. Once per long rest, when a creature harms you or an ally within 30 ft, name it oath-bound for 1 minute. Once each round when an ally hits that creature, that ally adds your proficiency bonus to the damage. Burden: abandoning the oath has serious cultural consequences.

Aeldari spirit-lens. Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute, you can see Invisible and Hidden creatures within 60 ft, cannot be Surprised, and your ranged attacks ignore Light Cover. Burden: The item carries a psychic echo noticeable to Aeldari and Warp-sensitive beings.
The Door That Would Not Break

+2 AC; Ogryn only; counts as a Slab Shield and has no Speed penalty. If you do not move, up to two Small or Medium allies directly behind you have Full Cover. Once per long rest, when a weapon attack hits you, reduce that attack's damage to 0. Burden: it is enormous and impossible to conceal.

Black-market data-sigil. Once per long rest, produce a convincing identity, access token or ownership record appropriate to the current settlement or institution; for one scene, gain advantage on Deception and Investigation checks that rely on it. Burden: every use risks attracting whoever originally issued the stolen credentials.
Disadvantage on the first Intelligence or Wisdom test after each rest.
Cannot use Heavy or two-handed weapons; disadvantage on tasks requiring both hands.
Speed reduced by 10 ft; disadvantage on saves against being knocked prone.
Maximum HP reduced by your character level.
Disadvantage on sight-based Perception and ranged attacks beyond normal range.
Environmental smoke, gas and exertion cause Exposure one step faster when that system is in use.
Cannot take reactions during the first round of combat.
No universal combat penalty; choose one social context in which the scar changes reactions.
